name: Valentina Herrera
bio:
Valentina's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rebuilding engines alongside her grandfather in their small town workshop. This passion led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where she specialized in material science and advanced manufacturing techniques. After graduating, she honed her skills at a local rally team before joining Century Motorsport.

As a fabricator, Valentina is known for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to quickly adapt to changing demands. She possesses a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics and the intricate relationship between design and performance. Her approach to fabrication is rooted in a collaborative spirit, always seeking input from engineers and drivers to ensure the final product meets the highest standards of precision and functionality.

What sets Valentina apart is her unwavering commitment to innovation. She consistently explores new materials and fabrication methods to enhance vehicle performance and reliability. Her deep understanding of composites and additive manufacturing makes her a valuable asset to the Century Motorsport team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Valentina is of average height, with a strong build reflecting her hands-on work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of humming tango tunes while working on intricate parts.
Insists on using a specific type of Argentinian yerba mate during breaks.
